findings.statement: Resolved: the current final-replay source hash matches the adjudication-code binding in freeze cc6397b0aea83d910105b15c5fb2f701ac4ff4def2858deb55c283d7cc396aa9. decision_sets_equal constructs nonempty decision_id-keyed maps, rejects missing, empty, non-string, or duplicate IDs, compares full decision payloads, ignores only file order, and causes replay instability to raise. Independent mutations confirmed order passes while empty, missing, extra, content-different, invalid-ID, and duplicate-ID cases fail. Pre-audit replay rebuilds all records and all four normalization variants agree.

findings.counterexample: Treating first-round agents as votes, allowing an OPEN testable BLOCKER, or permitting human review to override a technical rejection would bypass the evidence-first gate.
findings.pass_condition: All 24 testable first-round BLOCKER findings remain RESOLVED with 24 PASS ledger entries; predecessor outputs remain evidence rather than votes; no human technical override appears.
findings.statement: Resolved: all 32 first-round findings were inspected. The 24 BLOCKER findings are RESOLVED and map one-to-one to 24 PASS derived-test records; there is no unresolved testable BLOCKER. Four OPEN WARNING findings preserve cost and future-work uncertainty, while the single OPEN ERROR is carried separately as ADA-002C-HR-002. First-round peer access is NONE, all decision judge_decisions lists are empty, and the hash-bound audit checks forbid majority-vote and human technical-gate fields rather than treating agent verdicts as votes.
